text:
sam: quick idea — tighten postmortem follow-ups after last week's cache outage. sketch below, open to tweaks.
jess: yes please. that one drifted off our radar. need concrete owners + dates so things don't sit.
sam: proposed lightweight timeline template:
```
Day 0: draft postmortem + initial owners assigned (IC tags)
Day 3: owner commits remediation plan (WIP PRs, ETA)
Day 14: implementation check-in (PRs merged or blocker note)
Day 30: verification + monitoring signals updated
Day 60: regression review + close or escalate
```
alex: i like Day 3 commit. can we add a weekly short tracker line so PMs can see status?
morgan: +1 on a weekly tracker. low-friction: one row per action with owner, status, blocker, next-check date. google sheet or a small section on the postmortem doc.
sam: proposed roles: IC (rotation every 6 weeks), remediation owner (explicit per item), PM reviewer, SRE verifier for rollout/monitoring. owners required to put an ETA in Day 3 commit.
alex: volunteer for next IC rotation (happy to take the slot). also happy to own remediation tracking for outage-2026-03 until it's stable. @morgan can you note that?
incident-bot: Reminder set: "check-in: outage-2026-03 action items" in 14 days for @alex
jess: i'll prototype the tracker sheet tonight. thinking columns: action id, description, owner, start, eta, status, blocker, next_check, linked PR.
sam: ok action list (assignments + due dates):
1) tracker prototype (jess) — due EOD tomorrow
2) timeline template into runbook section (sam) — due Wed
3) rotation schedule update + call for volunteers (morgan) — due next Mon
4) tag current postmortem with action ids and owners (alex) — due in 2 days
alex: noted and will sync with owners. i'll add a quick status row now.
morgan: thanks. once tracker exists we'll do a 15-min weekly follow-up sync for outstanding items until 80% closed. keep it timeboxed.
sam: if nobody objects i'll roll this into the incident runbook PR after tracker proto is up. small ask: owners please keep the tracker updated before weekly check-ins.
jess: no objections, i'll drop the sheet link here when done. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks all.
morgan: closing loop — will post rotation roster in #people-ops and ping for coverage.
